instruction: Look at freecad_task-19_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench throughout; activate the Body, create new sketches on the required faces or planes, and complete all fused features in the same Body using GUI additive and subtractive features. Create a motor mounting plate with a raised register and multiple slots. Keep the base plate 160 x 90 x 10 mm. Add and fuse a raised circular register pad centered at (80,45), diameter 68 mm and height 10 mm. Cut a vertical center bore of diameter 36 mm through the entire part. Cut six vertical through bolt holes of diameter 7 mm on a 27 mm bolt-circle radius centered at (80,45), starting on +X and repeating every 60 degrees. Cut four obround mounting slots of total length 30 mm along X and width 8 mm at centers (35,22), (125,22), (35,68), and (125,68). Also cut two lightening slots of total length 42 mm and width 8 mm centered at (80,18) and (80,72). Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-19_output.step using the GUI only; no external scripts.
